title: 証城寺の狸囃子 (Shōjōji no Tanuki Bayashi — Raccoon-Dog Drumming at Shōjōji)
description: On a moonlit night the raccoon-dogs (tanuki) of Shōjōji Temple in Kisarazu come out to beat their bellies like drums — 'ぽんぽこぽんのぽん'. The priest challenges them, but the tanuki win. Based on a legend at an actual Jōdo Buddhist temple in Chiba Prefecture. First published December 1924; song added January 1925. The song became an international hit when Eartha Kitt recorded it in 1955. Same PD creators as シャボン玉 (野口雨情 d.1945, 中山晋平 d.1952).
